name: Golden Judge's Breastplate
body:
Source Inner Sea Gods pg. 251
Aura faint abjuration, enchantment, and transmutation CL 3rd
Slot armor; Price 5,110 gp; Weight 30 lbs.
Description
This gold-colored +1 breastplate has a large, ornate symbol of a vault key on one side of the chest. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Sense Motive checks. The wearer can use command and peacebondUC each once per day.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, command, owl's wisdom, peacebondUC; Price 2,730 gp
